headline: Everblue Plans R$10 Billion in Credit via Exclusive Fund Model
summary: Everblue plans to issue R$10 billion in credit through a fund factory model, aiming to quadruple its volume in exclusive funds by 2027 to help companies finance production chains.
why: Corporate credit expansion and structured financing funds provide alternative capital channels for supply chain management and corporate growth.

impacts.name: Everblue
impacts.why: The company announced expansion plans for its credit fund operations.
